notes: «فكتب عبد الله إلى أبي موسى يسأله» is Ibn Abbas asking inside the shaykh's story: he is only in the scene (rule 5) and is left out
the saying is Abu Musa's written reply quoting the Prophet; Abu Musa is the last link (rule 6)

fixes.reason: RWY puts Ibn Abbas between the shaykh and Abu Musa; the text has him only as the asker inside the story

evidence.quote: فكتب عبد الله إلى أبي موسى يسأله عن أشياء
